JCM203.raw:
Medium data

Search for medium no. = [203].
Unless otherwise stated, sterilize media by autoclaving at 121°C for 15 min.

203   PYRODICTIUM BROCKII MEDIUM

Salt base solution (see Medium No. 151)  1.0     L
Trace minerals (see Medium No. 151)  10.0     ml
Yeast extract (BD-Difco)  2.0     g
Sulfur (powder)  30.0     g
Resazurin  1.0     mg
Mix components except sulfur, adjust pH to 5.5 with H2SO4 and autoclave under a N2 gas atmosphere. Steam sulfur for 3 hr on each of 3 successive days. Aseptically distribute the medium and sulfur into culture vessels (e.g., 20 ml of the medium and 0.6 g sulfur in 120 ml serum bottles) under a stream of a H2-CO2 (80:20, v/v) gas mixture and seal with butyl rubber stoppers. Prior to inoculation, add per litter the following solution (autoclave and stored under a N2 atmosphere):
5% Na2S·9H2O solution (pH 7.0)  10.0     ml
Readjust pH to 5.5, if necessary. Pressurize inoculated vessels to 200kPa H2 -CO2 (80:20, v/v).

151   PYROCOCCUS MEDIUM

Salt base solution (see below)  1.0     L
Trace minerals (see below)  10.0     ml
Citric acid  5.0     mg
Yeast extract (BD-Difco)  1.0     g
Bacto peptone (BD-Difco)  5.0     g
Sulfur (powder)  30.0     g
Na2S·9H2O  0.5     g
Resazurin  1.0     mg
Mix ingredients, except sulfur and Na2S·9H2O, and adjust pH to 6.5 with H2SO4. Sterilize by filtration under a N2 atmosphere. Steam sulfur for 3 hr on each of 3 successive days. Neutralize Na2S·9H2O as a 5% solution, and autoclave under a N2 atmosphere. Aseptically and anaerobically add sterile sulfur to the medium. Prior to inoculation, add the sterile Na2S·9H2O solution, and readjust pH to 6.5, if necessary.
